title: Session panel shows only this session's work; project-wide items move to a Project info view

fields.why: TJ is overwhelmed by project-wide items in each session's right panel

text: TJ: the right panel in a session should ALWAYS only show what this session's agent is doing, never project-wide things. Move project-wide items (project goal, rest of the project, backlog, questions for other work, do-not list, completed) to a 'Project info' or 'Project backlog' view opened from a button, e.g. on the dashboard project card. Panel is InspectorView.swift; card is DashboardView.swift. Ask TJ before deciding where each section goes. Do not touch SessionsView.swift or AppModel.swift (tab work in progress). Do not restart the app.
